turnaround_reason: Accelerating broadband subscriber losses (-120k in Q1 FY26) to fixed wireless and fiber halved CHTR from ~$286 to the low-$150s; the just-closed $34.5B Cox merger (completed Aug 20, 2026) plus the Liberty Broadband acquisition create a 70M-home footprint and ~$800M synergy target.
bullish_points: Cox + Liberty Broadband deals closed today; ~$800M cost synergies and national scale
Extremely cheap on cash flow: forward PE ~3.5, large FCF generator
Spectrum mobile bundling (free year for Cox customers) and full product launch in Cox markets mid-Sept
Convergence/mobile attach is a structural offset to broadband softness
bearish_points: Broadband subs still bleeding; fixed wireless + fiber competition is secular, not cyclical
Debt/equity ~442 -- very high leverage amplifies both equity upside and downside
Large integration risk absorbing Cox at the same time subscribers erode
Basing but still -17.7% below 200d MA; no confirmed trend reversal
catalyst: Cox integration executing on synergies plus broadband sub losses stabilizing as mobile convergence scales
catalyst_timing: Q3-Q4 FY26 (mid-Sept Cox-market product launch; next earnings late Oct 2026)
suggested_trade: Starter spot for the deep-value/FCF thesis; add only if broadband net-adds inflect
key_risk: Broadband losses keep accelerating while high leverage limits flexibility, turning the cheap multiple into a value trap
would_skip_if: Q3 broadband subscriber losses widen further or Cox integration shows early synergy slippage
